positions.title: Associate Principal Product Manager
positions.description:
- I am the PM for core process mining capabilities with a focus on object-centric process mining (OCPM), working across Knowledge Models, PQL, Studio, and PI graph teams to deliver scalable solutions.

- Owned the Process Knowledge Layer, enriching customer data with business semantics to power the PI Graph. making dashboard deployment faster and analyses more insightful.

- In less than a year I took it from a concept to an MVP being featured prominently in the keynote at Celonis annual conference.

positions.title: Senior Product Manager
positions.description:

- Took Knowledge Models from a prototype to full product with high adoption over the past years.

company.name: Celonis
company.description:
Celonis makes processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform takes the data from the systems you already use, and presents you with a living digital twin of your end-to-end processes. It’s system-agnostic, without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving processes. 

Because when processes work, everything works. 

Since 2011, Celonis has helped 1,000+ of the world’s largest companies to realize value across the top, bottom, and green line.

Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Find out more at www.celonis.com.
